transcript:
Header: Date: 2026-03-12 15:00 UTC | Duration: 48 minutes | Attendees: Ethan Cole (Redwood AE), Mira Patel (Redwood SE), Samira Khan (Redwood CSM) ; Jorge Alvarez (HelixChannel Head of Partnerships), Priya Sharma (HelixChannel AE), Liam O'Neill (HelixChannel Solutions), Nia Roberts (Channel Ops)

Summary: quick status of three prioritized deals, alignment on who owns next outreach, request for perf numbers for NovaCorp, ask for pricing lanes for co-sell.

[00:00] Ethan Cole: Hey everyone, thanks for hopping on. Quick roll call and then we'll go through the pipeline. Jorge, Priya, you good?
[00:17] Jorge Alvarez: Yeah all good Ethan, thanks. Quick timezone note, we're on London and SF split but this time works.
[00:25] Priya Sharma: Hi all, ready.
[00:30] Ethan Cole: Great. Mira, do you want to kick off with the NovaCorp ask?
[00:36] Mira Patel: Sure - NovaCorp wants to run a perf pilot, they care about tail latency under 150ms for chat and about cost per token. My thought is Dedicated with 4x A100 or similar, or a hosted with burst policy but that gets pricey.
[00:50] Liam O'Neill: Quick interruption - they do have sensitive PII in prompts, so VPC or private deployment is a hard requirement from their security team.
[01:05] Mira Patel: Right, thanks Liam. If VPC is required then Redwood Private or Dedicated in their VPC is the path. We can do a short on-prem style pilot in a private cloud. Performance-wise we can show baseline but will need sample prompt shapes.
[01:22] Priya Sharma: We have their engineering contact. I'll share example prompts.
[01:28] Ethan Cole: Awesome. Moving on to Acme - where are we on the joint demo and exec intro?
[01:35] Priya Sharma: Acme is high priority. They liked the idea of co-sell. They asked about SOC 2 and audit logs - standard. They also asked about cost comparisons vs Bedrock.
[01:48] Samira Khan: We have SOC2 Type II and can share the security pack; audit logs are available and KMS integration too. I'll send the pack after this call.
[01:58] Jorge Alvarez: For Acme, our sales lead wants a joint demo with both of you on the call. Can we target week of 3/23?
[02:08] Ethan Cole: Yes, that works. We'll prepare a demo tailored to Acme's workflow. Priya, can you coordinate and send the contact list?
[02:15] Priya Sharma: Yep will do.
[02:20] Ethan Cole: Great. Quick note on pricing - we demoed two lanes: hosted subscription vs dedicated reserved. For co-sell we typically recommend a 70/30 split if Helix brings the logo, but that's flexible per deal.
[02:36] Jorge Alvarez: Got it. We'll want clear margin lanes. Can you share the spreadsheet?
[02:40] Ethan Cole: I'll send the updated pricing spreadsheet after the call.
[02:45] Priya Sharma: On Meridian, they are small but fast-moving; they want low latency and are price sensitive. Any suggestions?
[02:55] Mira Patel: For Meridian, likely hosted with caching and KV prefix reuse, plus quantized model to cut costs. We can recommend a smaller model variant if their SLAs allow.
[03:10] Nia Roberts: Question on compliance: if Meridian needs data residency in EU, does Redwood have region guarantees?
[03:18] Samira Khan: Yes, we have region-specific deployments and can lock data residency; we'll include that in docs.
[03:25] Priya Sharma: Back to NovaCorp perf - what exact numbers can we promise?
[03:31] Mira Patel: We avoid over-promising. For Dedicated with pinned model and 4-card config, 90th p95 tail latencies for short chats should be sub-100ms token generation, end-to-end depends on prompt shapes. We'll provide empirical numbers from similar trials.
[03:50] Jorge Alvarez: Do you have any recent benchmarks we can show to customers?
[03:55] Mira Patel: I have internal ones; I need permission to share sanitized sheets. Ethan will push a sanitized baseline.
[04:05] Ethan Cole: Yes I'll prepare a trimmed benchmark for customer sharing.
[04:10] Priya Sharma: On co-sell ops, Helix needs a clear lead assignment workflow. Who does Redwood want as the primary contact on joint opportunities?
[04:20] Ethan Cole: Typically AE leads ownership for contract, SE for technical. For this motion, Samira will support commercial and Mira will own technical.
[04:30] Jorge Alvarez: Works for us. We'll mirror that on our side - Priya as primary AE, Liam as SE.
[04:37] Priya Sharma: Quick question on trial length - NovaCorp asked for a 6-week pilot; is that feasible?
[04:44] Mira Patel: 6 weeks is fine if we scope performance tests in first two weeks and ramp traffic gradually. We'll want a test harness and sample throughput.
[04:56] Nia Roberts: And billing during pilot? Do you invoice or use credits?
[05:02] Ethan Cole: For pilots we usually do a pilot agreement with nominal fees to cover reserved capacity; we can work the commercial terms per deal.
[05:10] Jorge Alvarez: On competitive positioning, customers keep asking why Redwood vs Bedrock or Anthropic. What are the succinct points?
[05:20] Ethan Cole: Short answer: predictable latency/SLOs, cost controls (batching, KV cache), and options for private deployment. Also our observability and rollouts are enterprise-friendly.
[05:32] Priya Sharma: Customers also like that you support model variants and quantization best practices.
[05:38] Mira Patel: Yes, and we can show quality regressions monitoring tied to evals; that resonates with product teams.
[05:45] Jorge Alvarez: Ok. For Acme, they will ask about SLA - can Redwood commit to a 99.9 availability on Dedicated?
[05:54] Samira Khan: For Dedicated we have SLA tiers that can hit 99.9 with reserved capacity and redundancy; enterprise contracts cover that.
[06:05] Liam O'Neill: Technical question - if we go Dedicated in their cloud account, how will KV cache be shared across instances?
[06:12] Mira Patel: Good question. Our runtime manages KV cache per instance but we offer prefix sharing strategies; details depend on model and workload. We'll include a short tech note.
[06:25] Priya Sharma: Can we get a one-page tech appendix for sales?
[06:30] Mira Patel: Yep I'll produce a 1-pager with architecture diagrams and perf knobs.
[06:35] Ethan Cole: Cool. Let's run through each active deal quickly and confirm owners and status. Acme: owner Priya/Ethan, joint demo week of 3/23, security pack to Acme by Samira.
[06:48] Priya Sharma: I'll confirm Acme availability and send proposed agenda.
[06:53] Ethan Cole: NovaCorp: need sample prompts from Priya, Mira will prepare perf baseline and proposed Dedicated config, pilot agreement draft from Samira.
[07:03] Priya Sharma: I'll drop prompts by tomorrow.
[07:07] Mira Patel: I'll prepare baseline and config doc.
[07:10] Meridian: Quick pilot recommendation hosted + quantization; Priya to re-open conversation with product team, Ethan to follow up on margin lanes.
[07:20] Jorge Alvarez: Also want to flag a smaller lead - Vertex Labs - they asked for a price estimate; can we provide a ballpark?
[07:27] Ethan Cole: Yes, I'll add Vertex to the pricing spreadsheet.
[07:30] Nia Roberts: Question - how do partner referrals get credited in CRM? Do we need a deal registration?
[07:36] Ethan Cole: We prefer deal registration in our portal; I'll loop in partnerships lead for process.
[07:42] Jorge Alvarez: Ok. A couple of tactical asks: 1) share pricing lanes, 2) sanitized perf benchmarks, 3) co-sell one-pager, 4) joint intro email template. Can you confirm?
[07:56] Ethan Cole: Yes, all confirmed. Those are the main deliverables from Redwood.
[08:02] Priya Sharma: Great. Anything else on the technical side?
[08:06] Liam O'Neill: One more - for NovaCorp we may need KMS integration and HSM support; can Redwood support those?
[08:14] Samira Khan: Yes, KMS integrations supported; HSM requires legal and infra scoping but doable. We'll route through our security team.
[08:25] Mira Patel: I'll add a short note about encryption options in the tech appendix.
[08:30] Ethan Cole: Alright, let's capture next steps and make sure due dates are clear.
[08:36] Jorge Alvarez: Quick scheduling note - can we make the exec intro before the demo? They want to see commitment.
[08:44] Ethan Cole: Yes we'll do an exec intro the week prior. I'll send an intro email with Jorge included.
[08:51] Priya Sharma: I'll coordinate Acme contacts and availability.
[08:55] Ethan Cole: Anything else? If not we'll wrap.
[09:00] Jorge Alvarez: No, that's it. Thanks everyone.

Recap (verbatim): Redwood to send pricing spreadsheet, co-sell one-pager, sanitized perf benchmarks; Helix to send contact lists and sample prompts. Joint demo scheduled for week of 2026-03-23 (Acme). NovaCorp pilot scoping to start with perf baseline due 2026-03-18.

End of call.
